scientific_stage: Step-0 calibration of three clearly separated survival regimes on one fixed composition graph
purpose: Construct G0/G1/G2 as three global admissibility-query regimes with clearly separated matched-provider white-box sigma, while keeping graph, hidden provider process, workload, I1, and M0/M1/M2 methods unchanged.

naming_clarification.G0_G1_G2_role: sigma-regime labels for the final diagnostic battery, not different graph topologies
naming_clarification.historical_G1_DD3: retained only as graph-response due-diligence evidence and not reused as the final G1 sigma regime
naming_clarification.historical_G2_contracts: superseded for the final diagnostic battery; do not execute them after this contract is frozen

fixed_graph.network_invariant: exact frozen G0 symmetric network embedding, including PR=0.001 s on every physical link

hidden_whitebox_model.invariant: WB hidden provider process must equal the provider process that generated frozen I1

step0_calibration.role: Experimental-design calibration only. White-box data may choose G0/G1/G2 query boundaries but may not fit, select, weight, or repair any prediction method.

candidate_family.base: For each rho, forward-compose the frozen public I1 provider A_i(rho) through the exact fixed G0 graph.
candidate_family.scalar_tightness_rule: A_G(s,rho)=(s*l_base(rho), s*c_base(rho), q_base(rho)); one scalar s changes latency and cost bounds together and leaves quality unchanged.
candidate_family.reason: One-dimensional scalar tightness prevents Step-0 from overfitting separate latency/cost knobs and guarantees an interpretable ordered SLA-difficulty axis.

selection_rule_per_rho_and_regime.feasible: Every WB sigma point on H=60..240 must lie inside the regime's frozen interval, inclusive.
selection_rule_per_rho_and_regime.primary: Among feasible scales, minimize absolute difference between mean sigma on H=60..240 and the frozen target center.
tie_breakers_in_order: maximize minimum distance of the observed curve to the two regime boundaries
minimize absolute log(scale), preferring the smallest departure from the induced base query
selection_rule_per_rho_and_regime.cross_regime_order_required: scale_G2 < scale_G1 < scale_G0 for every rho

step0_calibration.failure_policy: If any rho/regime has no feasible candidate, ordering fails, or confirmation leaves its frozen sigma interval, stop. Do not tune this v1 contract after observing Step-0 evidence; use a separately named v2 design.

blind_prediction_protocol_after_calibrat.M0_applicability: Apply the frozen M0 boundary-containment precondition separately to each calibrated query. If a stricter query is not applicable, report M0 as NOT_APPLICABLE; do not fabricate a numeric M0 prediction. Raw local-product may be shown only as an explicitly labeled diagnostic.

evaluation.headline_figure: For each rho, compare WB/M0/M1/M2 over H for G0, G1 and G2 using identical graph and provider process.

next_gate: Run prepare-only. It must prove exact fixed-G0 graph reuse, D300/I1 provider-process identity, frozen support, scale grid, regime bands, and disjoint seed banks without generating Step-0 white-box evidence.
